## Walkthrough The provisioner migrates to external-provisioner v6, updates dependencies and release tooling, revises topology synchronization, and adds optional orphaned VolumeSnapshot finalizer cleanup with runtime integration and documentation. ### Changes **Provisioner v6 and release alignment** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Module, dependency, and deployment alignment**
`go.mod`, `pkg/...`, `test/e2e/...`, `.prow.sh`, `deploy/...`, `CHANGELOG/...`|The module, imports, dependency pins, deployment image, E2E paths, and 6.3.0 release notes are updated for v6.| |**Topology synchronization and fallback**
`pkg/capacity/topology/...`, `pkg/controller/topology.go`, `pkg/controller/topology_test.go`, `cmd/csi-provisioner/csi-provisioner.go`|Topology readiness now follows informer synchronization, incomplete cached node labels are refreshed, and topology worker startup moves into the main run flow.| |**Snapshot finalizer cleanup**
`pkg/controller/snapshot_finalizer_controller.go`, `pkg/controller/snapshot_finalizer_controller_test.go`, `pkg/features/features.go`|Adds periodic cleanup of orphaned snapshot source-protection finalizers based on pending PVC references and snapshot API availability.| |**Controller and release tooling updates**
`pkg/controller/controller.go`, `README.md`, `deploy/kubernetes/rbac.yaml`, `release-tools/...`|Adds specific snapshot-source errors, documents the sweep option, and updates release workflow pins, build images, and Go versions.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Provisioner participant SnapshotFinalizerController participant VolumeSnapshotInformer participant PersistentVolumeClaimLister participant SnapshotClient Provisioner->>SnapshotFinalizerController: start configured sweep SnapshotFinalizerController->>VolumeSnapshotInformer: synchronize snapshots SnapshotFinalizerController->>PersistentVolumeClaimLister: find pending snapshot references SnapshotFinalizerController->>SnapshotClient: remove orphaned finalizer ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `gnufied`, `mpatlasov`
